hypothesis: The worker-side response path clones the full response payload per routed response: write_response_frame serializes to_vec(response_line(&response)) where response_line inserts data.clone() (a full-payload tree clone taken only to be immediately serialized), then encode_private_frame copies the payload bytes AGAIN into a fresh whole-frame buffer (C4); additionally the DaemonResponse (the handler's data tree, C1) outlives write_response_frame, so the trim_freed_heap_if_large inside it frees C2+C4 but NOT C1 - repeated MB-class responses leave the handler trees' freed pages in the glibc arenas and the worker's RSS at the response peak. Removing C2 (serialize the line from the borrowed trees) and C4 (segmented frame write) and moving the response into the write (C1 drops before the trim) should cut per-response CPU by the clone+rebuffer cost and return the response-phase heap to the OS, with byte-identical wire frames (the supervisor's #2897 splice rides on them).
approach: pa-daemon/pa-types only: (1) protocol.rs response_line_bytes() - serialize the response line straight to bytes from &DaemonResponse (id?/type/command/success/data-or-error/errorInfo in the TS key order, each value via serde_json::to_writer, no intermediate tree); (2) pa-types framing write_frame_segments() - same wire bytes as write_frame, length prefix + header as one small write + payload written from the caller's slice under the same write lock, same length assertions; (3) Worker::write_response_frame consumes the response: serialize from the borrow, write segments, drop(payload) + drop(response) BEFORE trim_freed_heap_if_large; shutdown + session-client arms capture success before the handoff; peer.rs auth arms moved by value. response_line() and its 60+ supervisor callers unchanged; supervisor registry (#2914) and relay splice (#2897) untouched. Oracles: unit corpus equality vs the reference path (8 response shapes), 2 framing oracles, VM-level wire dumps b/c/a2 with A/A identity-leaf control + splice oracle on the candidate. Measurement: same-VM sequential ABBA (B,C,C,B) x 3 fixtures (synth-150k/synth-450k/canon-10mib), sha-asserted binaries, fresh daemon + fixture prehash per trial, per-op worker CPU jiffies + VmHWM/VmRSS + /proc/io deltas, append N=1 vs 100-append burst arms, fresh-worker single-op VmHWM attribution arms, v1.0 I/O gate (>=40 isolated fresh+sync_all+rename @0.5s + >=20 repeat-fsync) bracketing EVERY leg + pre/mid/post calibration.
parity_notes: Wire bytes PROVEN byte-identical: routed get_messages line (9,474,074 B canon-10mib / 1,444,621 B synth-150k), direct worker-socket get_messages payload, append ack (79 B), session header - b==c==a2; state/attach differ only in the #2897-documented identity-leaf sets (6/16 leaves) with ZERO new leaf paths vs the A/A control; splice oracle byte-exact ON the candidate. No capability/protocol/TUI-byte changes; internal worker-socket frames byte-identical; failure paths preserved (write-error eprintln + no response reuse; shutdown reply-before-exit with the outcome captured; attach/detach bookkeeping reads success before the handoff).
